display.title: Torah, the Best Thing of All, Chapter 2: Recap
display.summary_short: A short recap before chapter 2: Rabbi Akiva told the merchants on the ship that he carries a treasure worth more than all their gold and silver.
display.summary_long: This brief clip is the recap Uncle Yossi gave before the second chapter of 'Torah, the Best Thing of All'. Rabbi Akiva is on a boat with many wealthy merchants carrying expensive goods. When they asked what he had brought, he said he owned something more valuable than all the gold and silver in the world, which he never needs to hide or lock away, because he carries it wherever he goes and no one can take it from him. The puzzled merchants wonder what this honest-looking man could mean and where he hides it. Uncle Yossi promises that they are in for a surprise. The chapter itself is in the next file of the set.
